message: Vector Rebel 3.2.60: Pass an SCBA with one choice, or expand Fail / Missing to review 11 Pass / Fail questions and a comment.
releaseNotes: SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Fail / Issue or Missing expands a compact 11-question Pass / Fail review and mandatory equipment comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Live Vector was inspected: this SCBA form provides no native comment field, so comments are preserved locally in the per-item queue and never falsely represented as attached to an official submission. Inspections are not auto-submitted.
